summary: Continuous diagnostics and verified autonomy runtime

delivery.outcome: Publish and deploy continuous bounded curllm probes, durable incident deduplication, verified operator-authorized repair and Planfile handoff for protected development (STARTER-019).
nonGoals: No self-authorized source changes or review bypass
No interaction with user browser pages

architecture.decision: Use operator-owned configuration, serialized SQLite incident/outbox state, explicit argv probes and repairs, effect verification, and optional Planfile intake; source development stays with the protected controller.

dataChanges.description: New private incident database and event log owned by this monitor; no existing state or responsibility is migrated.

architecture.rollback: Disable deployed timer and revert feature commit.

validation.evidence: Dedupe, backoff, semantic failures, recovery, crashes and verified repairs tested.
Existing browser control and MCP protocol remain functional.
Native governance passes and CLI cycle/status retain evidence.
